name: Chaotic Mind
description: Future Crew's musicdisk of eight songs by Skaven
author: Future Crew

start.note: DosKit plays the first song in its menu, Amazonas. Up, Down and Enter pick another, Escape switches between the menu and the playing screen, and F10 returns to DOS.

hint: Chaotic Mind waits at its menu: press Enter to play the highlighted song. Up, Down and Enter pick another, Escape switches screens, and F10 returns to DOS.
